rule: No poem is published twice and no poem is given to two poets (test/literature_uniqueness_test.dart). Two were one passage published in overlapping slices and are repaired to the whole passage (EXTRACTION_REVIEW_PHASE11_2026-09-26.json). The rest are below, with one found after those repairs (the excerpt's closing bayts quoted again on p. 50): fragments cut at a page break and reprints in another grade are retired into the record that prints the whole poem; one record that held four separate rubais keeps its own. Applied with tool/literature/resolve_duplicates.py.
